title: Items, version 1
description: A file under content/items/ (work order 003, scope 1). Holds a list of items. Each item has an id of the form item.<zone>.<name>, zone one of rustmoor, cinderworks, thunderhead, global (Jeremy, answer to work order 003 Q5), a name, and one line of flavour text of at most 20 words. Nothing else is required yet; stats, prices and calibration come in later work orders. 'revision' (file or item) is optional and exists only so a register row's revision can match what it points at. maxWords is a keyword this repo's validator adds: whitespace-separated words.
